title: Palindrome Linked List
description:
Given the head of a singly linked list, return true if it is a palindrome or false otherwise . 

 Example 1: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2021/03/03/pal1linked-list.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 head = [1,2,2,1]

Output:
 true
```

 Example 2: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2021/03/03/pal2linked-list.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 head = [1,2]

Output:
 false
```

 Constraints: 

 The number of nodes in the list is in the range [1, 10 5 ] . 
 
 0 <= Node.val <= 9 

 Follow up: Could you do it in O(n) time and O(1) space?
